newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish TPSA to increase phone prices on June 1.
newsitem.headline: Polish TPSA to increase phone prices on June 1.

text.p: Polish telephone monopoly Telekomunikacja Polska SA (TPSA) will from June 1 increase the price of one telephone call unit by 0.01 zlotys to 0.18 zlotys, TPSA said in a statement on Wednesday.
TPSA last increased prices by 0.01 zlotys in February. It did not give the reason for the price increase.

In the same statement TPSA said it would also increase the price of a connection between public and mobile telephones, which are presently between 0.7 and 1.4 zlotys a minute, depending on the time of the call.
